name: Liftonia
summary:
Liftonia is a ski resort management simulation in which players plan pistes, build ski lifts and operate a mountain resort. Snowfall, wind and temperature drive a simulated snowpack that accumulates, drifts, settles and melts. Players manage snowmaking with snow guns and groom runs with snowcats. Resorts are based on real mountains, built from official elevation data with their true lift and piste layouts.

The resort also operates through the summer season, when visitors who do not ski still come to the mountain. The camera pans, rotates and zooms around the mountain, and the simulation can be paused while planning.
